row.evidence: Toggl Plan's help centre lists SAML2 SSO on the Business plan and says new people must be invited from the Team page because automatic user creation is 'not available just yet'; no SCIM is documented.
row.notes: No native SCIM; status unchanged from June. Toggl Plan is no longer sold standalone: toggl.com/plan/pricing/ redirects to the unified Toggl pricing page (Starter $9/u/mo annual, $12 monthly; Premium with SSO $16 annual, $24 monthly; Enterprise contact), and Toggl Plan 'remains available and supported for existing users'. Legacy Toggl Plan tiers per the help centre: Team $8 annual / $9 monthly, Business (SAML SSO) $13.35 annual / $15 monthly. June's 'Team $9' was the monthly price. Users are managed by invite, or through the OAuth-only API v5 members endpoints.

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint is documented in the Toggl Plan help centre, the Toggl Plan API v5 reference or the unified Toggl pricing page. SSO is SAML only and the Plan help centre says automatic user creation is not available yet.

endpoints.purpose: Add a new member by name (not linked to an existing user)
Add a user to a group

limitations.text: API access only on behalf of a Toggl Plan user via a registered OAuth 2.0 application; no API-key or service-account option documented.
Docs show the workspace id as a literal path segment (/1/members); paths here use {workspace}.

user_api.notes: API v5 reference is dated ©2020; plan gate for API use is not stated.

okta.notes: OIN 'Toggl Plan' app: page markup checks SAML only (last updated Nov 2020). A separate suite-wide 'Toggl' OIN app is also SAML/SWA only.

fallbacks.notes: CSV import covers tasks, not users.
